title: Logitech Wireless MK320 Keyboard Only, Black - Tested, Used
categoryName: Computers/Tablets & Networking:Keyboards, Mice & Pointers:Keyboard & Mouse Bundles
descriptionText:
Enhance your typing experience with this Logitech Wireless Desktop MK320 Keyboard. Enjoy the convenience of a QWERTY keyboard with a maximum DPI of 1000. This keyboard is perfect for those who value comfort and efficiency while typing. The sleek black color of the keyboard adds a touch of sophistication to your workspace. 

Connectivity is made easy with its wireless feature, giving you the freedom to move around without any restrictions. This Logitech BASE model keyboard is perfect for those who desire a simple, yet efficient keyboard without any custom bundles. Its USB interface makes it easy to connect to your computer and start typing right away. This keyboard is a great addition to your computer setup and will provide you with a comfortable and efficient typing experience.
